main.name: StatMap
main.blurb: Every league, every kind of stat — single seasons, career totals, height, All-Star counts. No warm-up.

nba.name: StatMap NBA
nba.blurb: Career per-game averages only. One league, one kind of number, so you can actually calibrate.
nba.note: Questions are being written and verified. The game opens when its pool is big enough to run without repeating and every number in it has been re-derived from the source dataset.

mlb.name: StatMap MLB
mlb.blurb: Career rate lines for hitters and pitchers — averages, ERAs, per-nine rates.
mlb.note: Questions are being written and verified. The game opens when its pool is big enough to run without repeating and every number in it has been re-derived from the source dataset.

nfl.name: StatMap NFL
nfl.blurb: Career per-game and per-touch rates, from the 1999 season forward.
nfl.note: Questions are being written and verified. The game opens when its pool is big enough to run without repeating and every number in it has been re-derived from the source dataset.

nhl.name: StatMap NHL
nhl.note: No open NHL dataset has been found that covers whole careers and can be re-derived independently. The candidates checked so far are either play-by-play events (which would mean inventing our own season totals with nothing to check them against) or unreachable. This game opens when there is a source that passes the same bar as the others, and not before.

cfb.name: StatMap College Football
cfb.blurb: Career per-game rates for college careers.
cfb.note: The open college-football data we can reach starts at 2014 and is play-by-play level. Career totals built from it would be our own arithmetic with no second source to check them against — two readings of one file agreeing with each other is not verification. This game opens when there is a source that passes the same bar as the others.

psu.name: StatMap Penn State
psu.note: Same blocker as the college-football game, plus a sharper one: most of the Penn State careers worth asking about are from before 2014, which is where the reachable data begins.
